author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting same notes, quick and slow notes, hearing endings that sound finished, and keeping up together, with a French dancing song.

classes.title: Step onto the bridge
classes.goal: Hear the song, then rest one finger on each of five keys, thumb on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: One finger for each key: five fingers, five keys

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child rest one curved finger on each lit key, thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Rest one finger on each key, thumb on C.
classes.bridge: Your thumb stands on C, at the start of the bridge.

intro.caption: Let's dance on the bridge
intro.parentCue: sway together, then put your child's thumb on C.

games.caption: Thumb on C, then step up
games.parentCue: Point to each finger as it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one finger on each key, thumb on C.

classes.title: Three C's, four D's
classes.goal: Learn the first line and count how many times each key plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting how many times the same key plays

classes.parentPrompt: Count aloud with your child: C, C, C is three; D, D, D, D is four.
classes.childAction: Play C three times with your thumb, then D four times.
classes.bridge: C, C, C are three big steps onto the bridge; the D's dance four.

intro.caption: How many C's? How many D's?
intro.parentCue: count each key aloud as it plays.

games.caption: On the bridge: C, C, C
games.parentCue: Hold up three fingers as it plays

games.caption: Now dance: D, D, D, D
games.parentCue: Count the four D's on your fingers

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting three and four same notes.

classes.title: Climb the bridge: E, F, G
classes.goal: Learn the dancing line: the child climbs E, F, G; the grown-up plays the low notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs up three keys, then drops down low

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low B and G yourself; your child plays E, F, G and C.
classes.childAction: Climb E, F, G with fingers three, four, five.
classes.bridge: E, F, G climb up the bridge; the low notes on the left are the river.

intro.caption: Climb up the bridge
intro.parentCue: you play the low notes, your child plays from C.

games.caption: Climb the bridge: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Point to each finger before it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: climbing three keys with three fingers.

classes.title: Two dances, one home
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear which dance lands home on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: The first dance stops low; the second one lands home on C

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the next word if your child gets stuck; cheer when the song lands on C.
classes.childAction: Play the whole song slowly and listen for the home ending.
classes.bridge: Bridge, dance, bridge, dance, and the last dance lands home on C.

intro.caption: Which dance lands home?
intro.parentCue: sing the next word if your child gets stuck.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing in order and hearing a finished ending.

classes.title: Quick-quick dancing feet
classes.goal: Practise the quick D's slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two quick notes fit in the time of one walking note

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'quick-quick, walk' as your child plays the D's slowly.
classes.childAction: Play D quick-quick, walk, hold, with finger two.
classes.bridge: Quick-quick D's are dancing feet; the long D is a bow.

intro.caption: Quick-quick, walk, and hold
intro.parentCue: say the words as your child plays.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and walking notes.

classes.title: Steady steps, slow dance
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one to four keeps every note evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' softly while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while you count to four with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Each bar is four even dance steps across the bridge.

intro.caption: Slow and steady dancing
intro.parentCue: count one to four softly as you go.

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count one to four out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing evenly, counting to four.

classes.title: Dance on the high bridge
classes.goal: Play the song in a higher place on the piano with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, moved to a higher home, sounds lighter

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your child's hand to the next C up: same fingers, same song.
classes.childAction: Move your hand to the high C and play the same song.
classes.bridge: The same dance on a higher bridge, to the right: lighter, tinier feet.

intro.caption: Same song, up high
intro.parentCue: slide your child's hand to the next C up.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Dance with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep dancing!
classes.bridge: The music dances round and round; join the circle and keep turning.

intro.caption: Dance along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Bridge dance for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, light and bouncy like a dance.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing light and bouncy, like dancers on a bridge

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; dance teddy round and round while your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play light and bouncy for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Light fingers are dancing feet on the old stone bridge.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: dance teddy round while your child plays.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing light and bouncy, start to end.
